scope: Unchanged released decoders of block headers: the TPraos BHeader of Shelley and Alonzo (decoder versions 2 and 5), the Praos Header of Babbage and Conway (7 and 9) and the Leios Header (Dijkstra's 12), each read with decodeFullAnnotator, a header body alone with decodeFull, and a ledger Block holding a Shelley-to-Conway header; definite, indefinite, detached (an empty indefinite list with the fields after it) and non-minimal forms of the header, its body, a VRF certificate, the operational certificate, the protocol version and a Leios announcement, with the refusals around them and the bounds of the body size and protocol version; for each accepted case the header hash over the bytes read, the block body hash of a block, and getSignableRepresentation of the header body, the bytes the KES signature is checked over; no ledger rule, signature or VRF proof is checked

praosHeader.note: HeaderBody and HeaderRaw are RecD records (203-229); getSignableRepresentation re-encodes the body at its major version (113-117)

tpraosHeader.note: BHBody and BHeaderRaw read their fields inside decodeRecordNamed (193-241); getSignableRepresentation (170-171)

leiosHeader.note: HeaderBody, HeaderRaw and EbAnnouncement are RecD records (92-104, 229-257); getSignableRepresentation (139-142)

ocertRule.note: the TPraos KES check, verifySignedKES over the header body

group.note: CBORGroup reads a list with decodeRecordNamed (27-35)

decCBOR.note: CertifiedVRF reads its list with enforceSize (568-573)
